R2 AUDIT: THE WIDENED PREDICATE HAS NO PRODUCER THAT DOES NOT PASS THROUGH THE CHART-TYPED ONE.

Fresh-context audit of the eight/ten DivisorFamilyAff*.lean files (I-0521 checks). All three named checks come back CLEAN — see the separate memory item. This is the one real gap, and it is a throughput gap, not an error.

WHAT IS TRUE. IsLocallyCertifiedAff is inhabited from exactly two directions:
 (a) isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_isLocallyCertified (DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean:249) — via the chart-typed pin, so it produces nothing the fixed-pair design could not already produce;
 (b) the hypothesis-shaped gates isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_exists_away (Zar:206) and isLocallyCertifiedAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation (Assemble:117), which take a CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff / (AffCoverData, AffAdaptation, IsCertified) at every prime and repackage it.

WHAT IS MISSING. Nothing constructs an AffAdaptation over a cover with a straddling piece for an actual divisor. Compare the chart-typed side, which has BOTH an extraction (exists_divisorAdaptation, DivisorFamilyExtraction.lean:54) AND a field-case certificate (DivisorFamilyFieldSurj.isCertified_of_deg:104, all seven clauses from a degree hypothesis). The widened side has neither: no exists_affAdaptation, no isCertifiedAff_of_deg, no AffAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor. So the strictly-larger predicate is, at HEAD, only as populated as the strictly-smaller one — the widening is structurally complete and mathematically unexercised.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE R2 CLAIM. The R2 payoff is 'a straddling divisor has an affine-open certificate though it has no chart-typed one'. No landed declaration exhibits that. AffCoverData.ofSwallowingPiece (Swallow.lean:140) assembles the cover but takes W and its affineness as inputs; SwallowedBy is a separate hypothesis; and nothing produces either from a divisor. The honest state is: the widened TARGET exists and receives the old material; the widening has not yet certified anything new.

CONCRETE NEXT STEP, in order of value: (1) an affine-open analogue of exists_divisorAdaptation over ofSwallowingPiece; (2) the widened field case (AffAdaptation over a field: every module free, so six of seven clauses are instances and only the rank needs deg_presentationDivisor, which is currently stated only for DivisorAdaptation); (3) then a divisor-level producer of W and SwallowedBy, or an explicit statement that 0B8B stays an axiom-free hypothesis of the lane.

      LinearMap.range ((A.pullback R' hc.projective_colength).deltaLeft -
        (A.pullback R' hc.projective_colength).deltaRight)) :=
  let hc' := A.isCertified_pullback R' hinf hc
  ⟨hc'.finite_colength, hc'.projective_colength, hc'.finite_glued, hc'.projective_glued,
   hc'.rankAtStalk_glued, hc'.flat_coker_incl, hc'.flat_coker_diff⟩

/-! ## Building a widened cover with a straddling piece -/

namespace AffCoverData

/-- **The widened cover from a straddling affine open plus a cover of the rest.** `W` is the
affine open containing the support (the Stacks `0B8B` piece); `Ws` is any finite family of
affine opens which, together with `W`, covers the curve.  The straddling condition itself is
`SwallowedBy` and is a separate hypothesis — this constructor only assembles the cover. -/
noncomputable def ofSwallowingPiece (W : (relCurve C R).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    {m : ℕ} (Ws : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens) (hWs : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (Ws i))
    (hcover : W ⊔ (⨆ i, Ws i) = ⊤) :

  pieces := Fin.snoc Ws W

    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hW
    · intro i; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hWs i
  cover := by
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => ?_
    have hz : z ∈ W ⊔ (⨆ i, Ws i) := by rw [hcover]; trivial
    rcases (Opens.mem_sup ..).mp hz with hzW | hzWs
    · exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨Fin.last m, by rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hzW⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hzWs
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i.castSucc, by rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hi⟩
